name: Decompose monolith into http, auth, and router modules
description: Split monolithic src/monolith.ts into src/http.ts, src/auth.ts, and src/router.ts with clean re-exports in src/index.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Decompose src/monolith.ts into modular files: 1) src/http.ts: Request, Response, createResponse, 2) src/auth.ts: verifyApiKey, 3) src/router.ts: handleRoute. In src/index.ts, re-export all symbols from http, auth, and router. Delete src/monolith.ts. Ensure no circular dependencies exist and test/modular.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: src/index.ts re-exports all public types and functions
